verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs say AI Chat searches across your meetings to answer questions. They also describe natural-language search over past calls, and meeting-transcript search across all time periods via the MCP server. Nothing in the pack shows that answers come with sources or citations back to specific meetings, and the vendor claims have no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documented source citations in AI Chat answers, hands-on or independent corroboration of cross-history Q&A accuracy.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
